I will plant beans on this small plot using seed I can manage to get, and I will rely mostly on family work because the plot is only 0.08 hectare. I do not plan to use chemical fertilizer because beans can still do reasonably well without it and fertilizer is expensive for me. I will use some manure if I can get it, and I may use a little chemical spray only if pests or weeds become a problem. I will not irrigate because here in Mbeya I depend on the seasonal rains.
